verdict.rationale: Docs describe webhook events (e.g., appointment.completed), real-time notarization notifications, and HMAC-SHA256 signature verification for incoming webhook payloads, indicating an event-driven webhook system exists. However, there's no explicit documentation of a subscription/registration endpoint or full event catalog for AI-native automation. Missing for 10: explicit webhook subscription/management API, full list of subscribable event types, and independent confirmation of webhook reliability.
